questions.explanation: 笔记的「建造魔法王国」定位到 Alice 的想象游戏。capacity for 后出现 creativity，题目把帮助培养这种能力改写为 may help develop。
原文列出棋盘游戏需要遵守规则并轮流行动；题面已经给出后者。
questions.paraphrase: follow rules and take turns → involve rules and turn-taking

questions.evidence: people in the world now live in cities
questions.explanation: 文段先讲城市人口，再讲游戏机会变少。空格说明人口增长的地点，填 cities。
questions.paraphrase: people now live in cities → populations of cities

questions.explanation: 原文列出交通风险及家长对犯罪的担忧，两空可以互换。
被犯罪侵害的担忧对应 fear of crime。第 4 和 5 题按一组批改，顺序不限。
questions.paraphrase: protect … from crime → fear of crime

questions.evidence: greater competition in academic learning and schools
questions.explanation: 学业和学校里的竞争加剧。空格要接在 increased 后，填 competition。

questions.evidence: the evidence to base policies on
questions.explanation: 国际组织已经开始制定政策，缺的是作为政策基础的证据。
questions.paraphrase: base policies on → support new policies

questions.evidence: the impact it has on the child's later life
questions.explanation: 题面把「对孩子以后人生的影响」换写为「对孩子其余人生的影响」。
questions.paraphrase: later life → the rest of the child’s life

questions.evidence: a key predictor of academic performance
questions.explanation: 自我调节能力可预测学业表现，对应题目所说的自控好、以后在学校表现好。
questions.paraphrase: academic performance → do well at school

questions.evidence: useful in the diagnosis of neurodevelopmental disorders
questions.explanation: 观察孩子如何玩有助于发现身心状况的线索，甚至辅助诊断某些障碍。
questions.paraphrase: diagnosis → information about possible medical problems

questions.evidence: Children wrote longer and better-structured stories
questions.explanation: 结果以所有孩子为整体，文章没有比较男孩和女孩的写作收益。
questions.paraphrase: 找不到题目新增的性别比较

questions.evidence: not a single child said this
questions.explanation: 有了乐高活动，全年没有孩子说不知道写什么，与「孩子想不出点子」相反。
questions.paraphrase: they didn’t know what to write about → had problems thinking up ideas

questions.evidence: the importance of play has been lost in recent decades
questions.explanation: 文章明确说近几十年来游戏的重要性被忽视，这直接支持今不如昔的比较。
questions.paraphrase: importance has been lost → regard as less significant
